Package org.yuemi.mmoaccessories.api.storage

Interface AccessoryStorage

public interface AccessoryStorage
Pluggable storage backend for accessory data.

Implementations store one record per player, keyed by the player's UUID. The record is a list of MMO Items item ids in slot order (with empty slots represented as the empty string). The list length is always equal to the sum of all slot types' max-slots, with empty slots filled in as empty strings. Backends are free to compress the list (e.g. drop trailing empty strings) on save and re-hydrate on load.

Shipped backends: pdc (default), sqlite, mysql, mongodb. Add a new backend by implementing this interface and resolving it through AccessoryStorageFactory.create(String) (or wiring a new case onto AccessoryStorageFactory.create, and registering the implementation in your build).

  • Method Details

    • initialize

      void initialize(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin plugin, org.bukkit.configuration.file.FileConfiguration config)
      Initialise the backend.

      Called once when the plugin enables (after the storage type has been resolved from config.yml). Implementations read their own config block (e.g. storage.sqlite.*, storage.mysql.*, storage.mongodb.*) and prepare any connection pools.

      Parameters:
      plugin - the plugin instance
      config - the plugin's config.yml

    • loadAccessories

      @NotNull @NotNull List<String> loadAccessories(UUID playerUuid)
      Load the list of equipped item ids for a player.

      The returned list is in slot order: 

         index 0        = BELT[0]
   index 1..2     = GLOVES[0..1]
   index 3..4     = RING[0..1]
   index 5        = NECKLACE[0]
      Empty slots are represented as the empty string.
      Parameters:
      playerUuid - the player's UUID
      Returns:
      the item-id list, never null (empty if the player has no saved accessories)

    • saveAccessories

      void saveAccessories(UUID playerUuid, @NotNull @NotNull List<String> itemIds)
      Save the list of equipped item ids for a player. Replaces any existing record.

      Empty strings in the list represent empty slots; trailing empties are accepted but the storage may compress them.

      Parameters:
      playerUuid - the player's UUID
      itemIds - the item-id list (in slot order)

    • clearAccessories

      void clearAccessories(UUID playerUuid)
      Remove the player's record entirely. Used by the /wipe command and on player data reset.
      Parameters:
      playerUuid - the player's UUID

    • shutdown

      void shutdown()
      Tear down the backend. Called when the plugin disables or when the storage type is changed at runtime. Implementations must close any open connections, file handles, and connection pools.

    • getTypeName

      @NotNull @NotNull String getTypeName()
      Returns:
      the storage type name ("pdc", "sqlite", "mysql", "mongodb", or a custom name). Used for logging and config.yml identification.
